title: Important Update to Binance Referral Commission
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will update how referral commissions are calculated for Spot and Futures on a  gradual basis  according to the following timeline: Spot: Starting from 2026-04-29 Futures: Starting from 2026-07-15 From the respective effective dates above, referral commissions will be calculated based on net fees, defined as transactional income after deducting any applicable market maker rebates. All referral commissions are calculated according to the following formula:  Commission = Net Fees × Commission Rate This update ensures that commission payouts more accurately reflect the actual net fees generated.  No action is required from you, the change will be implemented automatically and reflected in future commission payouts. Please note that these changes do not apply to  Crypto-as-a-Service, Exchange Link  and  Link & Trade  clients. Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-04-27 Notes:  This announcement was updated on 2026-05-29 to clarify the referral commission format and revise the Futures Trading timeline to 2026-07-15. This announcement was updated on 2026-05-12 to revise the Futures trading timeline to 2026-06-15. This announcement was updated on 2026-04-27 to clarify that Crypto-as-a-Service, Exchange Link, and Link & Trade clients are excluded from these changes.
